name: paddlr
description: Agent-agnostic software engineering framework. Simple on the surface, sophisticated underneath.

interface.shortDescription: Software engineering discipline, TDD, and project memory
interface.longDescription: Equips Codex with systematic software engineering practices: structured repository exploration, risk-proportional workflows, Test-Driven Development (TDD), evidence-based verification, and persistent project memory (docs/paddlr/) across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Draft feature specifications and implementation plan with Paddlr
Run TDD to implement a new feature (RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR)
Systematically investigate and debug a failure with sre-debugging
